title: Define grating geometries
action: Set up the geometrical parameters for the two grating designs: 94 GHz (h=0.6 mm, h3=0.78 mm, D=0.8 mm, l=0.28 mm) and 220 GHz (h=0.252 mm, l=0.135 mm, D=0.5 mm, h3/h=1.3).
description: Parameters needed for subsequent dispersion calculations.

title: Compute dispersion curves and identify surface mode
action: Implement the mode-matching technique for a shielded three-stage grating using the explicit matrix equation given in the Approach section. Solve the dispersion equation (no beam term) to obtain dispersion curves for the 2nd pass band for both designs. Identify the surface mode branch (vph < 0) and determine the beam velocity range for surface-mode synchronism.
description: Core calculation of dispersion relation; required to find the operating beam velocity ranges.

title: Compute electronic frequency tuning ranges
action: For the 94 GHz design, vary the beam velocity over the determined surface-mode range (approximately 0.094c to 0.113c) and find the operating frequencies at fundamental harmonic synchronism (intersection of beam line with surface-mode dispersion curve). Compute the tuning range as (f_max - f_min) / f_center × 100 %. For the 220 GHz design, similarly determine the beam velocity range from the dispersion condition and compute the tuning range percentage. Write both percentages to the output JSON file.
description: The final scored quantities: electronic frequency tuning ranges for the two designs, compared to the paper's reported values.
